context:
Start with correctness issues: grouped histogram outlier identity and summary-box width
accounting. Then address box plot label UX, no-color heatmap presentation, and summary-box
text-fit behavior for long content.

Reuse existing no-color differentiation helpers in `ASCIIChartOptions` and avoid introducing
new global rendering modes. Keep changes localized to chart renderer modules plus targeted
visualization tests.
description:
Recent no-color/greyscale ASCII chart behavior is still suboptimal in real outputs,
especially for head-to-head comparisons. User-reported regressions show that structural
differentiation and readability goals are not consistently met across chart types.

Confirmed issues from live output and code review:

1. **Box plot series labels are over-truncated and include a low-value marker prefix**
   (e.g., "■ DataFusion (.."), making series names harder to read.

2. **Grouped histogram outlier semantics are incorrect**: outlier detection is tracked by
   `query_id` only, so when one platform is an outlier for a query, all platform bars for
   that query are rendered as outliers.

3. **Grouped histogram legend markers do not match plotted glyphs** in no-color mode:
   legend uses marker set (■/◆/...) while bars use fill patterns (█/▓/...), causing
   unnecessary cognitive load.

4. **Heatmap no-color output is visually sparse and hard to scan**: values are centered
   instead of right-aligned and column delineation is weak, producing mostly-empty columns
   and poor comparability.

5. **Heatmap row-truncation indicator path appears dead** and should be validated/fixed
   if intended behavior is to support row truncation messaging.

6. **Summary box comparison rows overflow box width in no-color mode** because visible
   width accounting excludes structural pct arrows (e.g., `+6.2%↑`), pushing the right
   border out by one column.

7. **Summary box best/worst rows can overflow with long query IDs** because they are
   not wrapped or truncated before border padding.

8. **Summary box title can overflow the box** because title text is centered without
   width clamping.

9. **Summary box two-column mode drops comparison percentages** when environment data is
   present, losing key comparison context.

anti_patterns.dont: encode outlier state as query-only in grouped mode
anti_patterns.instead: track outliers at platform+query bar identity
anti_patterns.why: it marks non-outlier peer bars incorrectly

anti_patterns.dont: hide comparison percentages in two-column summary mode
anti_patterns.instead: include both absolute and percent deltas
anti_patterns.why: users lose the key regression/improvement signal

anti_patterns.dont: pad summary-box rows using raw percentage text length
anti_patterns.instead: compute visible width from rendered text

anti_patterns.dont: relax tests to accept mismatched legend-vs-bar semantics
switch MCP/CLI no-color flows back to ANSI color dependence
anti_patterns.why: those paths must remain readable without ANSI

preserves.behavior: CLI/MCP chart type interfaces and output contracts remain backward-compatible
Colored rendering behavior for ASCII charts remains unchanged when use_color=True
Existing query ordering and chunk-splitting behavior in ASCIIQueryHistogram remains stable
Heatmap scale semantics (fast→slow normalization and displayed numeric range) remain correct
Summary-box line lengths always match configured chart width in no-color and ASCII/Unicode modes
Summary-box two-column mode continues to show comparison deltas (percent change), not just absolute values

work_units.summary: Fix grouped histogram outlier granularity to be per-bar (platform+query), not per-query
Make grouped histogram legend glyphs semantically match rendered bar glyphs in no-color mode
Improve box plot series label layout to avoid marker-driven truncation and preserve informative names
Improve no-color heatmap density/readability with right-aligned numeric cells and clearer column separators
Audit heatmap truncation logic, fix dead row-truncation path if needed, and add regression tests
Fix summary-box comparison-row width accounting so no-color pct arrows do not overflow borders
Clamp/wrap summary-box title and best/worst rows to prevent border overflow with long text
Restore percentage-change visibility in two-column summary mode and add width-regression tests
